description: CHECK-IN-LANDING (F4 criterion 3, the delivery's gate at p99 10 s): whether the infra delivery's tower/gate success rides its landing job, posted by the live service right before the merge (forge.OriginForge.check, the Origin app's key of CHECK-RUN-AWS), instead of the client's own publish through the port and its wait for the service's word (1.0 to 2.4 s of each delivery on 13/11).
